title: Compare within-cluster and other-cluster distances
description: You follow the silhouette calculation for the existing labels.

steps.description: You build squared pairwise distances from dot products and squared norms. Negative roundoff values are set to zero before taking square roots.
You compute a as the mean distance to other points with the same label. Removing index i excludes the point's self-distance.

steps.question: Does b average distances to all other clusters together?
steps.answer: It takes the smallest of the separate other-cluster mean distances. Each candidate mean uses only one other label.

steps.description: You calculate (b-a)/max(a,b) for each point and average the results. The recorded mean silhouette score for k=3 is 0.460.
